result.title: Totem: Object-Centric 3D Memory for World-Consistent Video Generation
result.summary: Generating coherent videos grounded in a unified underlying world remains a major challenge, particularly under large viewpoint changes, where existing methods often struggle to maintain stable representations of individual objects. To this end, we introduce Totem, an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation. Totem first represents each selected object as a persistent 3D memory aligned to a shared world frame, assigning it a dedicated state. Based on these memories, we design a dual-stream 3D conditioning architecture that combines object memories with scene geometry for target-view synthesis. Moreover, these object memories constrain the model's attention with 3D structural information, thereby preserving object surfaces and relative spatial layouts. Extensive experiments on world-generation and object-centric benchmarks demonstrate that Totem generates videos depicting a more object-consistent 3D world under challenging camera trajectories, while supporting versatile applications.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Totem，一种以物体为中心的 3D 记忆框架：为每个选定物体建立对齐统一世界坐标的持久 3D 记忆与专属状态，并用双流条件架构结合物体记忆与场景几何合成目标视角视频，同时以 3D 结构约束注意力以保持物体表面与相对布局。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作以持久化的物体级状态跨视角维持对象一致性，并提供结构约束注意力的机制，可供核查 LVR 中实体级状态抽象与视觉细节保有的思路，但属视频生成领域、与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
